dedupe_keys.name: three phase power flow calculation tool in excel

description: A CIRED working-group team publishes an Excel workbook for unbalanced three-phase low-voltage power flow. Zenodo provides a macro-enabled spreadsheet and explanatory PDF under CC BY 4.0. The public description says users can vary charging patterns of electric vehicles and grid detail to study phase imbalance without installing a dedicated power-flow package. This model can compare low-voltage feeder scenarios during charging-infrastructure planning. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. Coverage is user-entered networks within the workbook’s level of detail, not a prebuilt census of every distribution feeder. A limitation is that the page does not establish complete handling of neutral conductors, protection or dynamic charging controls; those details must be checked in the workbook and documentation. Excel macro security and version compatibility also matter. The workbook was not downloaded, no macro was executed and no voltage result was reproduced.
